description:
Look up Siren itself: where something is in the app (pages, tabs,
buttons), how a feature works, plans, prices, credits and policies.
Returns up to 3 sections, each with its docs link and its place in the
app (e.g. Ads → Sales). Call it before telling the human where to click
or what something costs; if it returns nothing, say you're not sure and
point to https://mysiren.ai/docs. Read only.

query.description: The question in plain words, e.g. "where do I set up tracking", "can Spark make videos".

name: siren_help
